title: Block previously rejected OpenArt history across all publication dates before expensive face verification
root_cause: Previously the canonical asset replacement guard rejected the most recently failed provider history but had no Brain cross-day rejection lookup. Re-offering an earlier history after a later rejected candidate consumed another image-verification evaluation. A 2026-10-25 Veo history 7lGMacfGJcGL3WGCF4XN was independently rejected on start and middle frames.
prevention_rule: For every original Mira router submit_asset Reel, query canonical Brain immutable failure occurrences by exact OpenArt history prefix across dates before downloading MP4 or running expensive AI. Any prior face/temporal/native-format rejection disqualifies exact provider history permanently; unknown Brain read fail closed. Preserve source winner, identity and confidence thresholds, original publisher authority and no-duplicate Meta write.
fix: Existing router uses read-only checkHistoricalMiraHistoryRejection in existing preflight-write.mjs; deterministic tests require cross-day dedupe, provider outage fail-closed and guard-before-expensive-work order.
outcome: Candidate PR only; no claim of production live, quality approval, or Instagram publication
